items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb]: 'Contracts / HĐ-2026-0187'; h1 'Contract HĐ-2026-0187'; badge 'In progress'; subtitle names vendor 'Minh Phát Technology Co., Ltd.'; dl has exactly 4 fields: Contract value, Vendor, Effective date, Expires

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: #renewBtn 'Renew contract' is the single filled primary button; #moreBtn opens #moreMenu with 'Duplicate contract', 'Download PDF', 'View audit history', and 'Terminate contract' as overflow menuitems; audit metrics.headerPrimaryActions=1

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a mailto: link and phone as a tel: link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: #contactsList rows show name (e.g. 'Phạm Thị Lan'), role ('Account Manager'), `<a href="mailto:lan.pham@minhphat.vn">`, `<a href="tel:+842839991234">`; first contact has a 'Primary' text badge

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: Table columns Due date/Amount(VND, text-right tabular-nums, e.g. '744.000.000 ₫')/Status are present, but row order is M1(Paid,15/03/2026), M2(Paid,30/06/2026), M3(Due soon,15/12/2026), M4(Not due,28/02/2027) — the 'Due soon' milestone (M3) is third, not first; rows are in plain chronological order rather than overdue/due-soon first

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: M3 row td: '15/12/2026 · due in 40 days' plus a 'Due soon' status badge text, not color-only

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Header dd: '28/02/2027 · in 115 days' under dt 'Expires'; Renewal tab repeats 'Current term ends: 28/02/2027 · in 115 days'

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: li: 'AMD-01 · Payment schedule revision', summary paragraph, footer 'Effective date 15/05/2026 · Approved by Lê Thu Hà · 12/05/2026'; AMD-02 shows 'Submitted by Trần Minh Quân · 22/10/2026' consistent with its 'Pending approval' status

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: No empty-state markup, loading skeleton/spinner, or inline error+retry UI exists anywhere in the HTML or script — sections only render populated data; audit env.loadingPlaceholders=0

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: #terminateDialog h3 'Terminate contract HĐ-2026-0187?' and body text naming the consequence ('Milestone M3 and M4 payments (992.000.000 ₫ remaining) will be cancelled...'); buttons 'Cancel' / 'Terminate contract' (verb label); script calls document.getElementById('terminateCancel').focus() on open, not the destructive button

notes: Clean, data-dense enterprise layout with no obvious template tells (no gradients, glass, uppercase tracked labels, emoji icons, KPI tiles, or decorative sidebar elements). Two functional gaps: milestone table does not reorder overdue/due-soon rows to the top (checklist item 4), and no section implements empty/loading/error+retry states (checklist item 8) — the page only ever renders its one populated data state.
